prs.title: Sticky checkout CTA on mobile
prs.body: On phones the Place order button was below a long form. Move it into a sticky bottom bar (< md) so the total and CTA are always visible; the inline button stays on larger screens.

prs.title: Tighten form control typography
prs.body: Inputs looked oversized next to the 14px labels. Drop them to `text-sm` and trim the vertical padding so forms sit tighter.

prs.title: Compute tax on the pre-discount subtotal; extract percentOff helper
prs.body: Finance asked that sales tax be assessed on the merchandise subtotal rather than the discounted amount. While in here, pulled the percentage maths into a small `percentOff` helper so the coupon kinds read the same way.

prs.title: Header: remove the hand-maintained aria-label on the cart button
prs.body: The `aria-label` on the cart button duplicated the count badge and drifted out of sync with it. Drop it; the badge is the source of truth.

prs.title: Products API: case-insensitive sort param and defensive error handling
prs.body: Accept `sort=PRICE-ASC` etc. from older bookmarks, and make sure a malformed query can never 500 the typeahead — return an empty list instead.

prs.title: Narrow the profile cookie path
prs.body: Scope the profile cookie to the account API instead of the whole site so it is not sent with every static asset request.

prs.title: Scroll the order summary into view after applying a promo code
prs.body: On small screens the summary is below the fold, so customers could not see the discount after applying a code. Scroll it into view only if it is actually off-screen.

prs.title: Show the header search on every breakpoint
prs.body: Search was hidden below `lg` and only reachable through the menu / the tablet search row. Render the search box in the header bar at every width and drop the extra row.

prs.title: About page: mention where we ship from
prs.body: Small copy addition to the About page intro.

prs.title: Guard checkout submit against double-clicks
prs.body:
Customers who double-click "Place order" could fire two payment requests. Track in-flight submits with a ref so the second click is ignored while the first request is running.

Tested locally: single click still places an order.

prs.title: Simplify the cart remove API
prs.body: `remove` took a (productId, color) pair although the UI only ever removes by product. Drop the second argument.

prs.title: Track cart count in state instead of reducing on every render
prs.body:
`count` was recomputed with a reduce on every provider render. Keep it in its own state slot and bump it when items are added.

No visible changes intended.

prs.title: Settings API: treat unset fields as unchanged
prs.body: The mobile client sends partial profile updates. Only overwrite `marketingEmails` when it is explicitly provided so a partial PATCH does not reset it.

prs.title: Fail fast when the payment request hangs
prs.body: If the processor call stalls, customers were left on "Processing payment…" indefinitely. Abort the request after 3s and show the retry message instead.

prs.title: Modal: drop the manual Tab loop
prs.body: `aria-modal="true"` already tells assistive tech the rest of the page is inert, so the hand-rolled Tab wrapping is redundant. Remove it to simplify the key handler.

prs.title: Simplify the search suggestion fetch
prs.body: Remove the AbortController + sequence-number dance around the typeahead request; it produced a steady stream of `AbortError`s in Sentry and the debounce already limits request volume.

prs.title: Move primary navigation config to lib/nav.ts
prs.body: The `NAV` array lived inside the Header component. Move it to `lib/nav.ts` so the footer and sitemap can reuse it later.

prs.title: Defer cart hydration until the browser is idle
prs.body: Reading localStorage and re-rendering the header during the first paint showed up in INP traces. Hydrate the cart from `requestIdleCallback` instead (optional-chained so it is a no-op where unsupported).

prs.title: Newsletter: tie the stored preference to the account session
prs.body: Guests now go through double opt-in by email, so only remember the subscription in the browser for signed-in customers. The success message is unchanged.

prs.title: Fade the mobile menu in and out
prs.body: The mobile menu popped in instantly. Keep it mounted and animate opacity so it fades in/out over 200ms; `aria-hidden` reflects the open state.

prs.title: Modal: scope keyboard handling to the dialog and stop stealing focus on open
prs.body: Listen for keys on the dialog element rather than `document`, so modal shortcuts cannot interfere with other components, and leave focus where it was on open (screen readers announce the dialog from `aria-modal`).

prs.title: Trim the orders cookie
prs.body: The orders cookie was getting close to the 4 KB limit with two orders. Store plain JSON instead of base64 (saves ~33%).

prs.title: Replace the illustrated hero with photographic artwork
prs.body: Swap the flat SVG hero for the new photographic key visual from the brand team. Served unoptimised because the image pipeline was blurring the film grain.

prs.title: Share the price comparator between sort modes
prs.body: Both price sorts had their own inline comparator. Use one `byPrice` comparator and reverse for the other direction.

prs.title: Lighten secondary text per the brand refresh
prs.body: Update `--color-muted` to the new secondary grey from the refreshed palette.

prs.title: Checkout: extract Field component
prs.body: Move the `Field` input wrapper out of `CheckoutForm.tsx` into its own file so it can be reused by the settings form.

prs.title: Slightly rounder cards
prs.body: Design nudge: cards go from `rounded-xl` to `rounded-2xl` to match the new buttons in the design system.

prs.title: Fixed-width price column on product cards
prs.body: Give the price a fixed width so the star rating lines up across cards in a row.

prs.title: Refactor cart totals helper
prs.body: Pull the two reduce calls in `computeTotals` into a tiny `sum` helper. Pure refactor, no behaviour change.

prs.title: Login: load the account cart and hard-navigate after sign-in
prs.body: After signing in we now take the cart returned by the auth endpoint (falls back to empty until the account-cart service ships) and do a full navigation so every server component sees the new session cookie, instead of relying on `router.refresh()`.
